desc: Derive the prefix-displacement representation of every smoke particle and prove the membership condition for a target cell.
Clarify which prefix states are inserted into the set and how campfire smoke generation corresponds to them.
Implement an O(N) hash-set solution, initializing the set with P_0=(0,0), querying before insertion, and reading/writing stdin/stdout as required.
Verify the implementation against all provided samples and edge cases involving repeated prefix positions and origin revisits.
